He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Lafayette Leopards men's basketball|Lafayette Leopards]]. ==High school career== Jaworski played basketball for Perkiomen Valley High School in [[Collegeville, Pennsylvania]].{{cite web |last1=Verlin |first1=Josh |title=Perk Valley alum Jaworski making a big splash for Lafayette |url=https://www.cityofbasketballlove.com/news_article/show/1069167 |website=City of Basketball Love |access-date=August 1, 2021 |date=December 4, 2019}} He averaged 22.2 points per game as a senior, and was named All-Area Player of the Year by ''[[The Mercury (Pennsylvania)|The Mercury]]''.{{cite web |last1=Stewart |first1=Samuel |title=Jaworski's commitment to his craft led Perkiomen Valley to new heights |url=https://papreplive.com/2017/04/17/jaworskis-commitment-to-his-craft-led-perkiomen-valley-to-new-heights/ |website=PA Prep Live |access-date=August 2, 2021 |date=April 17, 2017}} Jaworski committed to playing college basketball for [[Lafayette Leopards men's basketball|Lafayette]], his only other [[NCAA Division I]] offer coming from [[American Eagles men's basketball|American]].{{cite web |last1=O'Brien |first1=Rick |title=Perkiomen Valley's Jaworski commits to play basketball at Lafayette |url=https://www.inquirer.com/philly/blogs/rick-obrien/Perkiomen-Valleys-Jaworski-commits-to-play-basketball-at-Lafayette.html |website=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]] |access-date=August 2, 2021 |date=March 30, 2017}} He was also a standout [[American football|football]] player in high school and turned down over 20 [[college football]] offers.{{cite web |last1=McParland |first1=Caroline |title='The last go around' for senior sharpshooter Justin Jaworski, who looks to lead men's basketball to a deep playoff run in March |url=https://www.lafayettestudentnews.com/blog/2021/02/12/jaws/ |website=The Lafayette |access-date=August 2, 2021 |date=February 12, 2021}} ==College career== On November 29, 2017, Jaworski scored a freshman season-high 24 points in a 74–70 loss to [[Drexel Dragons men's basketball|Drexel]].{{cite web |last1=Arsenault |first1=Bill |title=College Corner: Lafayette getting a lift from Perk Valley grad Jaworski |url=https://www.pottsmerc.com/sports/college-corner-lafayette-getting-a-lift-from-perk-valley-grad-jaworski/article_1f5e5e65-a3f3-5642-aa9e-bdb0476a4170.html |website=[[The Mercury (Pennsylvania)|The Mercury]] |access-date=August 2, 2021 |date=December 17, 2017}} As a freshman, he averaged 10.8 points and 2.2 rebounds per game. On November 7, 2018, Jaworski posted a sophomore season-high 28 points and five rebounds in a 93–86 loss to [[Saint Peter's Peacocks basketball|Saint Peter's]].{{cite web |title=Jaworski's Career Night Not Enough in Season Opener |url=https://goleopards.com/news/2018/11/7/mens-basketball-jaworskis-career-night-not-enough-in-season-opener.aspx |website=Lafayette College Athletics |access-date=August 2, 2021 |date=November 7, 2018}} He averaged 14.6 points, 2.9 rebounds and 2.7 assists per game as a sophomore, earning Third Team All-[[Patriot League]] recognition. Jaworski shot 48.9 percent from three-point range, which ranked second in the nation.{{cite web |last1=Post |first1=Matthew |title='Jawsdropping' performance: Justin Jaworski closes season second nationally in three-point shooting, third team all-conference |url=https://www.lafayettestudentnews.com/blog/2019/03/15/draft-jaworski/ |website=The Lafayette |access-date=August 2, 2021 |date=March 15, 2019}} On February 1, 2020, he scored a junior season-high 32 points in an 82–70 win against [[American Eagles men's basketball|American]].{{cite web |title=Jaworski's career-high 32 leads Lafayette past American |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story?id=28614965 |website=[[ESPN]] |publisher=[[Associated Press]] |access-date=August 2, 2021 |date=February 1, 2020}} Jaworski missed the final seven games of the season with a torn [[anterior cruciate ligament]]. As a junior, he averaged 17.1 points, 2.8 assists and 2.7 rebounds per game, and was a Second Team All-Patriot League selection.{{cite web |title=Jaworski to Miss Remainder of 2019-20 Season |url=https://goleopards.com/news/2020/2/14/mens-basketball-jaworski-to-miss-remainder-of-2019-20-season.aspx |website=Lafayette College Athletics |access-date=August 2, 2021 |date=February 14, 2020}} On January 2, 2021, Jaworski made his senior season debut, recording a career-high 37 points, eight rebounds and four assists in a 90–89 overtime loss to [[Lehigh Mountain Hawks men's basketball|Lehigh]].{{cite web |last1=Arsenault |first1=Bill |title=College Corner: Senior Jaworski recovered and riding high for Lafayette |url=https://www.pottsmerc.com/sports/college-corner-senior-jaworski-recovered-and-riding-high-for-lafayette/article_15974bde-5929-11eb-97ff-13fee05b9038.html |website=[[The Mercury (Pennsylvania)|The Mercury]] |access-date=August 1, 2021 |date=January 17, 2021}} As a senior, he averaged 21.5 points, 3.7 rebounds and 2.3 assists per game. Jaworski was named to the First Team All-Patriot League and led the conference in scoring. He chose to forgo his additional year of college eligibility.{{cite web |last1=McCue |first1=Owen |title=Perkiomen Valley grad Jaworski hoping for chance to chase NBA dream |url=https://www.pottsmerc.com/sports/perkiomen-valley-grad-jaworski-hoping-for-chance-to-chase-nba-dream/article_b381f818-ef37-11eb-8e9f-1770393f25ec.html |website=[[The Mercury (Pennsylvania)|The Mercury]] |access-date=August 2, 2021 |date=July 27, 2021}} ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2021 NBA draft]], Jaworski joined the [[Atlanta Hawks]] for the [[2021 NBA Summer League]].{{cite web |last1=McCue |first1=Owen |title=Justin Jaworski to play for Atlanta Hawks in NBA Summer League |url=https://www.pottsmerc.com/sports/justin-jaworski-to-play-for-atlanta-hawks-in-nba-summer-league/article_d363283e-f2b9-11eb-81f6-733b5209759b.html |website=[[The Mercury (Pennsylvania)|The Mercury]] |access-date=August 2, 2021 |date=August 1, 2021}} He was signed by the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]] on October 16, 2021,{{cite web |last1=Shaw |first1=JD |title=Thunder Sign Olivier Sarr, Justin Jaworski |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2021/10/thunder-sign-olivier-sarr-justin-jaworski.html |website=HoopsRumors |access-date=October 21, 2021 |date=October 16, 2021}} but was waived the following day.{{cite web |last1=Almanza |first1=Clemente |title=Thunder regular season roster set |url=https://www.welcometoloudcity.com/2021/10/17/22730224/thunder-regular-season-roster-set |website=Welcome to Loud City |publisher=[[SB Nation]] |access-date=October 21, 2021 |date=October 17, 2021}} He subsequently joined the G League affiliate, the [[Oklahoma City Blue]].{{cite news |last1=McCue |first1=Owen |title=PV grad Jaworski to play in NBA G League |url=https://www.pressreader.com/usa/the-mercury-pottstown-pa/20211017/281861531695565 |access-date=November 9, 2021 |work=[[The Mercury (Pennsylvania)|The Mercury]] |date=October 17, 2021}} On February 12, 2023, Jaworski was traded from the [[Iowa Wolves]] to the [[Lakeland Magic]] in exchange for [[Simisola Shittu]].{{cite web | url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/magic-acquire-d-j-wilson-from-blue/n-5924193 | title=Magic Acquire D.J. Wilson from Blue | date=12 February 2023 }} On July 12, 2023, he signed with [[Napoli Basket (2016)|Napoli Basket]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA).{{Cite web|url=https://www.napolibasket.it/justin-jaworski-e-un-nuovo-giocatore-della-gevi-napoli-basket/|title=Justin Jaworski È Un Nuovo Giocatore Della Gevi Napoli Basket|last=|first=|date=July 12, 2023|website=napolibasket.it|publisher=|language=it|access-date=July 30, 2023}} On June 18, 2024, he signed with [[Baskets Oldenburg]] of the German [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL).{{Cite web|url=https://ewe-baskets.de/news/verpflichtung-justin-jaworski.html|title=Justin Jaworski: EWE Baskets verpflichten zweitbesten BBL-Scorer|last=|first=|date=June 18, 2024|website=ewe-baskets.de|publisher=|language=de|access-date=June 18, 2024}} On June 27, 2025, he signed with [[Bilbao Basket]] of the [[Liga ACB]].{{Cite web|url=https://bilbaobasket.biz/justin-jaworski-segundo-fichaje-de-surne-bilbao-basket/|title=Justin Jaworski, segundo fichaje de Surne Bilbao Basket|last=|first=|date=June 27, 2025|website=bilbaobasket.biz|publisher=|language=es|access-date=June 29, 2025}} On July 19, 2026, he signed with [[Basket Zaragoza|Zaragoza]] of the [[Liga ACB]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.acb.com/es/liga/noticias/justin-jaworski-de-bilbao-a-zaragoza-145625|title=Justin Jaworski: De Bilbao... ¡a Zaragoza!|last=|first=|date=July 19,
